To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the solutions of Stephani's rotating vacuum dust are generalized to the non-vacuum case, (ii) the solutions are of Petrovac type D and the solutions involve seven arbitrary function of a spacelife coordinate, (iii) the solutions admit a foliation of hypersurfaces of zero extrinsic curvature, and (iv) the solutions admit no Killing vectors.

Stephani's rotating solutions are the most general rotating dust solutions with vanishing magnetic part of the curvature tensor, the cosmological constant can be non-zero and the spacetime admits a foliation by timelike hypersurface of constant intrinsic curvature.

Stephani's rotating fluid solutions admit a foliation of spacelike hypersurices of constant intrinsic curvature, that the flow-lines of the dust are tangent to these spacelike hypersurface, and that the spacetime geometry, in general, has no isometries.

rotating dust solutions with a non-zero cosmological constant are more numerous than previously thought.
